actions.action: Bind confirmation to the explicitly selected slot
actions.mechanism: Keep selection identity independent of refreshed list positions so capacity changes cannot redirect a booking.
actions.implementation: Store the slot identifier and reviewed details. Submit that identifier to the existing atomic endpoint; require explicit reselection if booking details change.
actions.check: Reorder, remove, and modify slots between selection and confirmation. Assert no request targets an unselected identifier or silently changed details.
actions.risk: Identity checks must cover details, not just list positions.

actions.action: Keep confirmation and keyboard focus in place
actions.mechanism: Stable controls prevent five-second updates from moving the target while someone approaches it.
actions.implementation: Keep the review panel and confirmation control mounted. Patch capacity labels without reordering focused items; preserve visible keyboard focus. Stack the panel at 320 pixels.
actions.check: Refresh repeatedly during pointer travel and keyboard navigation. Verify unchanged control position, retained focus, and no horizontal scrolling at 320 pixels.
actions.risk: Status messages must not expand above and displace controls.

actions.action: Explain availability changes without a countdown
actions.mechanism: Persistent, nonurgent status distinguishes selection from reservation without imposing an additional race or dismissing the review.
actions.implementation: Show “Selected, not reserved; availability can change.” On invalidation, retain slot details and show an unavailable message with a keyboard-accessible recovery control and polite announcement.
actions.check: Invalidate the selection during review. Verify the message persists, announces once per transition, and neither moves focus nor automatically selects another slot.
actions.risk: Announcing every poll would overwhelm assistive technology users.

actions.action: Recover with retained preferences and explicit alternatives
actions.mechanism: Separate booking preferences from slot availability so a failed choice does not erase the person's work.
actions.implementation: Retain workshop, date range, time preferences, and entered form values. Offer matching alternatives with differences stated; require explicit selection before another confirmation.
actions.check: Invalidate a slot and force confirmation rejection. Verify preferences and form values survive, alternatives remain keyboard accessible, and nothing is booked automatically.
actions.risk: Alternatives are suggestions, not reserved replacements.

actions.action: Offer a stable list alongside the week view
actions.mechanism: A linear, preference-filtered presentation reduces precision demands without changing capacity allocation or creating privileged availability.
actions.implementation: Add a day-grouped list using native selection controls, descriptive time labels, and large targets. Share selection state with the week view; wrap content within 320 pixels.
actions.check: Complete selection, review, and unavailable-slot recovery using only a keyboard at 320 pixels. Switching views must retain the identical selected slot.
actions.risk: Two views must not develop conflicting selection or availability states.

actions.mechanism: An explicit submission state separates capacity rejection from uncertain network outcomes and prevents accidental duplicate requests.
actions.implementation: Route activation through one handler and prevent concurrent submissions. On rejection, retain the selection and preferences. On timeout, show an unknown outcome; never automatically retry a potentially successful request.
actions.check: Simulate repeated activation, capacity rejection, and a lost response after server acceptance. Verify one in-flight request and no fabricated success or definite failure.
actions.risk: Resolving unknown outcomes may require an existing booking-history channel.

actions.action: Expose stale availability rather than inventing certainty
actions.mechanism: Polling failures should change confidence in displayed capacity, not silently rewrite the selected slot or imply reservation.
actions.implementation: Track the last successful refresh. When refreshes fail, mark availability as unverified, preserve selection, and offer manual refresh without adding a countdown or bypassing atomic confirmation.
actions.check: Disconnect polling during review. Verify stale capacity is labelled, selection remains intact, and any booking success is reported only after endpoint acceptance.
actions.risk: Connectivity messages can clutter a narrow review panel.

actions.action: Measure recovery errors without scoring input speed
actions.mechanism: Outcome-based measures expose selection loss and inaccessible recovery without treating fast confirmation as successful access.
actions.implementation: Record selected/submitted identifier mismatches, unavailable reviews, capacity rejections, preference loss, and recovery completion. Test scripted invalidations at matched interaction stages; allow unlimited participant time.
actions.check: Verify delayed and immediate input receive identical success criteria. Report error denominators and keyboard/pointer results separately; do not rank participants by confirmation time.
actions.risk: Collect only necessary telemetry; avoid inferring disability from interaction speed.
